courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 鋼構巨型接頭焊接檢驗
related.titleEn: Welding inspection of major steel joints
related.transfer: 可遷移「摩擦型接頭的傳力機制」與「安裝前驗證試驗」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；鋼構巨型接頭焊接檢驗的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Force transfer in slip-critical joints" and "Pre-installation verification testing" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Welding inspection of major steel joints must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以夾緊力、接觸面等級、預拉方法與安裝前驗證，確保摩擦型與預拉接頭在施工及數十年使用中保持設計夾緊力；鋼構巨型接頭焊接檢驗則以以焊接程序、預熱與熱輸入控制、施工停留點與非破壞檢測，確保厚板全滲透焊接頭能承受設計力與地震、疲勞需求為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on securing design clamping force in slip-critical and pretensioned joints through clamp force, faying-surface class, pretensioning method and pre-installation verification, during construction and decades of service; Welding inspection of major steel joints centres on securing thick-plate complete-joint-penetration joints for design, seismic and fatigue demands through procedures, preheat and heat-input control, hold points and nondestructive testing, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「接觸面夾緊力與滑動係數」與「梁翼板全滲透開槽焊」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到鋼構巨型接頭焊接檢驗，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「超音波與相位陣列檢測」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Clamp force and slip coefficient” and “Beam-flange CJP groove weld”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Welding inspection of major steel joints, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Ultrasonic and phased-array testing", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 高強度螺栓預拉力施工
history.text: 二十世紀上半葉的大型鋼構以熱鉚接為主，1932 年通車的雪梨港灣大橋即由約六百萬支手工鉚釘組成。RCSC 於 1951 年 1 月發布第一版高強度螺栓接頭規範，使預拉螺栓逐步取代鉚釘，此後已出版 18 個版本；2025 年版撤除校正扳手法，並新增螺栓施工人員資格與承包商責任等條文。1979 年 Kemper Arena 屋頂吊架螺栓失效，以及 2013 年海灣大橋東段高強度錨桿在受拉後兩週內大量斷裂，都提醒工程師預拉、材料與氫脆控制必須一併管理。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Large steel structures of the early twentieth century were mostly hot-riveted; Sydney Harbour Bridge, opened in 1932, is held together by about six million hand-driven rivets. RCSC published its first specification for high-strength bolted joints in January 1951, letting pretensioned bolts gradually replace rivets, and has issued 18 successive editions since; the 2025 edition withdrew the calibrated wrench method and added provisions on bolting personnel qualifications and contractor responsibilities. The 1979 failure of Kemper Arena's roof hanger bolts and the 2013 fracture of many high-strength anchor rods on the Bay Bridge East Span within two weeks of tensioning both remind engineers that pretension, material and hydrogen-embrittlement control must be managed together. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「摩擦型接頭的傳力機制」到「螺栓紀錄、可追溯性與交接」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。
